events.title: Bright Beige Cozy Lounge

events.title: Chose Beige Two-Seat Modern Sofa, Geometric Wool Area Rug, Glass Column Floor Lamp

events.title: Checked each product 3 times on candidate 1
events.detail: Each check is a separate request with a close crop next to the catalog photo, and a product counts as a match when at least 2 of the 3 say match. Beige Two-Seat Modern Sofa: match 9, match 9, match 9. Geometric Wool Area Rug: match 9, match 9, match 9. Glass Column Floor Lamp: partial 6, partial 6, partial 6.

events.title: Judged the finished room again

brief: The old dark sofa makes the room feel gloomy. Make it brighter and cozier without painting or touching the floor.

render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 5 are the reference photos of products 1 to 3, in order.
1. Replace the dark brown three-seat fabric sofa with product 1: Beige Two-Seat Modern Sofa (sofa), real size 198.1 x 96.5 x 88.9 cm (width x depth x height). Centered against the window wall in the exact footprint of the old dark sofa, facing the TV. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Low-profile two-seat beige textured fabric sofa with plush back and seat cushions, slender arms, and dark tapered wood legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Add product 2: Geometric Wool Area Rug (rug), real size 182.9 x 121.9 x 0.8 cm (width x depth x height). Laid flat on the wood floor centered under the glass coffee table, long side parallel to sofa. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular low-pile rug in light beige wool with subtle embossed geometric medallion pattern and textured wool surface. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: Glass Column Floor Lamp (floor lamp), real size 33 x 33 x 149.9 cm (width x depth x height). Stands on the floor in the rear corner between the right arm of the sofa and the TV console, shade above seat height. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: Tall slender floor lamp with square black base, clear glass column with vertical black rod, topped by large white drum linen shade. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
